description: The President is the chief officer of Gray-New Gloucester-Raymond Little League, responsible for the league's overall direction, governance, and family-facing communications. This role facilitates board meetings, owns the season calendar (registration, clinics, assessments, drafts, playoffs, and All-Stars), makes weather/cancellation calls, and represents the league to District 6, Little League International, municipal partners, and sponsors. The President coordinates most recurring outbound communications and drives the annual cycle from fall planning and elections through spring startup, in-season operations, and post-season wrap-up.

calendar.title: Annual elections / officer slate approval
calendar.description: Fill and approve the officer slate for the coming year via board motion at the fall organizational meeting. Confirm voting officers with owning role and term year, plus non-voting staff; note open seats.

calendar.title: Set fall/winter board meeting schedule
calendar.description: Establish the offseason board meeting cadence (monthly or bi-weekly) and next-season planning windows.

calendar.title: Yearly policy and rules review
calendar.description: Review and adopt division rules, managers/coaches contract, and volunteer application for the coming year.

calendar.title: Next-season planning kickoff
calendar.description: Draft registration timing, clinics, assessments, calendar, and coaches trainings for the coming spring season.

calendar.title: Sponsor thank-yous and fundraising follow-up
calendar.description: Coordinate sponsor thank-yous (banners, signed jerseys, donation letters) and fundraising follow-up by donation tier.

calendar.title: Registration fees and open date decision
calendar.description: Set registration fees by division and the registration open date (historically 1/1) with the board.

calendar.title: Board Meeting - fall business
calendar.description: Facilitate the fall board meeting: financials, field projects, season calendar, motions/votes, and action items. President facilitates; secretary records.

calendar.title: Winter clinics planning
calendar.description: Plan January winter clinics (softball and baseball) - dates, gym space, coaches, budget, and session fees.

calendar.title: Assessment dates and structure
calendar.description: Set spring assessment/tryout dates and structure (stations, judges, snow/rain dates).

calendar.title: Abuse Awareness Training reset
calendar.description: Abuse Awareness Training resets October 1; ensure all board members complete it and hold current Safe Sport badges.

calendar.title: Board positions / open-seat recruitment
calendar.description: Confirm/retain roles, fill open seats, and recruit volunteers for the coming season.

calendar.title: Registration opens for spring season
calendar.description: Broadcast registration-open announcement to all families, including tee ball/coach pitch details, winter clinics, and custom-uniform sign-up deadline.

calendar.title: Assessments/tryouts planning
calendar.description: Plan player assessments: dates, stations, assessors/judges, equipment per station, check-in, and snow/rain date.

calendar.title: Spring training / indoor practice scheduling
calendar.description: Secure gym/YMCA space and schedule indoor practices with volunteers.

calendar.title: Rules / division review
calendar.description: Review division rules and interleague rule changes (farm system, coach pitch, age structure, playing-up).

calendar.title: Assessments reminder to families
calendar.description: Remind families of assessment dates, what to bring, parent meeting, medical release form, and per-division schedule.

calendar.title: Coach interviews
calendar.description: Invite and interview coaches; hold the board's ranked-choice vetting vote per division.

calendar.title: Coach selection and team counts
calendar.description: Motions to elect coaches and set the number of teams per level; review play-up/move-up requests for safety and balance.

calendar.title: Draft dates set
calendar.description: Set draft dates (held after the coaches meeting); enforce the 3/14 final custom-jersey registration deadline.

calendar.title: Season calendar finalized
calendar.description: Finalize the season calendar: clinics, assessments, coaches clinics, draft, field cleanups, first games, All-Star letters/dates.

calendar.title: Division draft invites
calendar.description: Invite head/assistant coaches to division drafts; propose candidate evenings and share coach lists and meeting link.

calendar.title: Draft results and team names
calendar.description: Release per-team rosters and practice schedules; collect ranked team-name choices with coin-flip tiebreaker.

calendar.title: Publish rosters after draft
calendar.description: Ensure drafted teams are entered into GameChanger and rosters posted (secretary executes).

calendar.title: Optional pre-season practices announcement
calendar.description: Announce optional pre-season/outdoor practices to families with GameChanger app link and weather caveats.

calendar.title: D6 updates and All-Star tournament dates
calendar.description: Distribute District 6 updates, interleague forms, and All-Star tournament dates.

calendar.title: Schedules update to families
calendar.description: Broadcast season-opening practice/game schedule status per division, directing families to GameChanger.

calendar.title: Snack Shack / concessions setup
calendar.description: Coordinate Snack Shack setup and staffing (including softball snack shack) for the start of games.

calendar.title: Field etiquette and start times broadcast
calendar.description: Broadcast field rules, start times, arrival windows, and safety/neighbor-respect reminders to families.

calendar.title: All-Star commitment forms due
calendar.description: All-Star commitment form due; coaches must submit a full slate of 14 players or the nomination is not accepted.

calendar.title: Playoffs scheduling and end-of-season BBQ
calendar.description: Schedule playoffs and plan the end-of-season BBQ / Home Run Derby.

calendar.title: All-Star team and coach selection
calendar.description: Hold All-Star roster votes by division/level and elect head/assistant coaches pending background checks.

calendar.title: All-Star roster board approval
calendar.description: Board approval of finalized All-Star team rosters per division.

calendar.title: Team-not-fielded notice
calendar.description: Notify families when a division does not have enough commitments to field an All-Star team.

calendar.title: Coach conduct reminder
calendar.description: Send gentle game-conduct reminders to coaches as summer ball proceeds, especially after any parent complaint.

calendar.title: Board Meeting - fall/summer business
calendar.description: Facilitate the post-season/fall business meeting: survey review, fall ball counts, banquet/parade planning, and board elections scheduling.

calendar.title: Following-year calendar drafting
calendar.description: Draft the following year's calendar: registration, clinics, assessments, coaches clinics, season dates, and All-Stars.
